title: How Far Away
label: ch:ml-distance
canDo: I can say that something is near or far, and ask how far away it is.

payoff.summary: From cold: both ends of the distance scale, the question that reads it, and the difference between pointing at a place and measuring across to it.
payoff.note: The chapter introduces exactly these four atoms and the payoff assesses all four. One of them, ethra, was already inside the age question the learner knows whole; the chapter lifts it out rather than teaching it fresh.
